start_scene_0_3s.description: SomnoArt clinical hypnogram showing absence of deep REM sleep cycles.

core_scene_3_7s.description: Explains how sleep apnea micro-arousals suppress restorative REM sleep.

end_scene_7_10s.description: Encourages consistent CPAP use to restore natural sleep architecture.

en.full_narration: Your sleep pattern changed during the night. Use your CPAP all night and discuss ongoing changes with your provider.
